name: Kaedehara Kazuha
quote: I am Kaedehara Kazuha, a wanderer who roams the land.
description: A wandering samurai from Inazuma and former member of the once-renowned Kaedehara clan. Gentle and carefree on the surface, he carries the weight of his past along with an ability to read the will of the wind.
